oneSentenceStory: Review combined reward balances and portability options in plain English to advance the Family Holiday Fund.
customerSituation: Customer is evaluating reward balances distributed across three partner programmes with a goal to fund a family holiday.
storyTension: Complexity of transferring points between partner programmes without incurring confusion or technical jargon.
customerResolution: Clear, jargon-free presentation of combined balances and transfer options directly supporting the Family Holiday Fund milestone.
primaryOutcome: Gain a clear, unified view of portability and goal progress across reward programmes.
prohibitedDetours: Introducing technical jargon or complex terms
Employing gamification elements like streaks or leaderboards
